title: Clubs and teams | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: Clubs and teams
hero.lead: Club, season and team define the context for many Kaderblick records. Players, coaches, appointments, matches, training records, tasks and responsibilities are displayed within it.

body:
Open My team

Under Team & Club, select My team. If several teams are assigned, switch through the tabs. Kaderblick shows:

  • team name, age group, league and player and coach counts,
  • a team banner if available,
  • training records if requirements exist or you may manage them,
  • the squad with shirt number, position or coach function,
  • the next released appointments and your open tasks.

Recognise your own assignment

Your own player or coach entry is highlighted and marked You. Kaderblick can also show your relationship to other people. Documents opens released player documents or their management if permitted.

Change the team banner

If authorised, choose a JPG, PNG or WebP file or drag it onto the banner area. An existing banner can be replaced; deletion requires confirmation.

Open appointments and tasks

Select an item under Upcoming appointments for details. My tasks shows title, status and available date information for open tasks. Complete views are in Calendar and My tasks.

My club and season overview

My club shows the sporting season overview for the assigned club. Choose a season. Each team displays age group, league, played, wins, draws, losses, goals, points, recent form and next match. Below, Kaderblick summarises the season’s leading scorers. Without club assignment or season data, an appropriate empty state appears.

Manage teams

Teams appears only with permission.

  • Season limits teams to the selected playing year.
  • Search team filters by text.
  • The table shows name, age group and league; page size and navigation are below.
  • Info opens details, pencil editing and bin deletion confirmation. Edit and delete only appear when allowed.
  • New team opens the same form without existing data.

Team details

Details show name and, where maintained, English name, description, code, cutoff date and minimum and maximum age. Edit and Delete depend on permission.

Create or edit a team

  • Banner: choose or drag an image.
  • Master data: required name, age group and league; choices come from maintained master data.
  • Default response deadline: automatic deadline for new matches and training sessions. After enabling, set period, weekday and time, plus week position for monthly periods.
  • fussball.de options: ID and URL. Load fussball.de data imports offered form data.
  • Match-time defaults: half duration and interval prefilled for new matches; empty fields use displayed defaults.
  • Team motivation: choose platform sayings, manage team sayings and enter a custom one.

Save applies changes. Cancel or X closes without saving. Deletion confirmation names the team; only the red delete action executes it.

Manage clubs

Clubs lists name, stadium and website. Search, pagination and actions work like Teams. New club opens the form.

Club details

Details show logo, names and active status. Club information contains abbreviation, stadium and linked venue with address, capacity, surface and facilities where available. Contact & Web contains website, email and phone.

Create or edit a club

  • Active controls active status.
  • Default language sets the club’s initial language.
  • Master data includes name, short name, facilities, stadium, colours, contact and founding year.
  • Venue links an existing location.
  • Contact & Web contains website, email, phone and logo URL.
  • fussball.de fields and Load fussball.de data are also available.

Roles and visibility

  • Players, coaches and linked accounts: see the teams and content returned for their relationships under My team.
  • Coaches managing records: receive additional training record tools.
  • Administration roles: see team or club lists and only permitted edit and delete actions.
  • Superadministration: has access to complete team and club administration in the verified demo.
